footer.tagline: The free management platform for Belgian non-profits and clubs.

notice.title: Legal notice
notice.body: asbl.club is a management platform for Belgian non-profit associations. This site is published as part of a final-year student project and is a prototype. The final publication details and the identity of the publisher and the host will be specified before any production release.

privacy.title: Privacy (GDPR)
privacy.body: asbl.club processes personal data in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation. The data collected is used solely to manage accounts, memberships and payments. You have the right to access, correct and delete your data, which you can exercise from your account area or on request. When the site hits a technical error, a report (the error, the page and the browser, with no personal data) is sent to our error tracking service, Sentry, hosted in the European Union.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: asbl.club uses only technical cookies necessary for the site to function, in particular to keep your session and remember your language. No advertising tracking cookies are placed without your consent.

landing.title: asbl.club, the platform for Belgian non-profits

hero.title:
Manage your non-profit,
simply and for free.
hero.lead: Member registry, online dues, events and ticketing, from a secure back-office in French, Dutch and English.
hero.trust: Payments via Stripe and Bancontact, straight to your account

features.title: A platform designed for volunteers
features.sub: No need to be tech-savvy, asbl.club replaces Excel files and manual bank reconciliations.

feature1.title: Members and dues
feature1.desc: Up-to-date registry, dues paid online and a receipt by email.

feature2.title: Events and ticketing
feature2.desc: Tickets, price categories and attendance control.

feature3.title: Online payments
feature3.desc: Dues and tickets by card or Bancontact, straight into the association's own Stripe account.

feature4.title: Security and audit
feature4.desc: Secure back-office, audit log, data export and account deletion.

step1.title: Create your ASBL
step1.desc: Enter your legal details and connect your account via Stripe.

step2.title: Invite your members
step2.desc: Share a join link or invite them by email.

step3.title: Collect online
step3.desc: Dues and tickets arrive directly in your account.

cta.title: Ready to simplify managing your association?
cta.sub: Free, no commitment. You only pay a commission on processed payments.
